notes.title: Pricing Update
notes.content:
Hello, long time no see!

We are permanently reducing the price of the game.
We really appreciate everyone who was there for us during Early Access, our 1.0 launch, and the first year of development, thank you so much for your support!

But we've moved on and are hard at work on our next game. We figured if we're no longer supporting this game, we might as well not ask for any money.

Yes, it's free now! You can endure the flurry of enemies and randomness without any charge. 
Stryx makes you suffer enough, doesn't he? ;)

notes.title: Infinite Incantation 1.0 Release!
notes.content:
We have seen all of the feedback and we feel the game has approached what we consider to be a good state for a full release. This does not mean updates will end– we anticipate more feedback after this update, so feel free to bring up discussion on the forums. And who knows, there might be more content to come in the future ;)

[h2]New Level![/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Introducing a new “Level 3”[/b] - Borzoi Blizzard
[*] A snow level with all-new enemies: Gnomes, Ants, WolfHounds, and Feather Stars, each with their own patterns and behaviours
[*] New achievements for this level, too
[/list]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The Spell card in the lower left now shows when it’s about to drastically change[/b] - the more you Mutate a spell in quick succession, the more likely it is to change the Spell Archetype.
[*] This will help you feel more in-control, as you can more clearly see how the mechanics work
[*] [b]The game will let you know of your next possible achievements in the upper right of the HUD[/b], so your level performance and how it relates to the results screen is clearer
[*] You can now rebind Spell selection from 1, 2, and 3 on the keyboard
[*] New Spell Archetypes: Laser (an Archetype that is mostly the laser effect), Helix, Rain, Stick, and Hyperbolic Barrage
[*] New Achievements: Having a high money multiplier while beating each level
[/list]
[h2]New Spell Effects![/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Every element can now come in Laser form[/b], allowing you to tear through enemies as if they were paper- oh, wait
[*] Lasers can either appear on spell projectiles or spawn on spell expiry
[*] Each laser applies the special effect of every element as well
[*] Lasers can be cast directly, or when the spell expires
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay and Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The old “Level 3” - Vagrant’s Volcano, is now Level 4[/b]
[*] Vagrant’s Volcano enemies, patterns, and difficulty have been adjusted accordingly
[*] [b]The final boss of Vagrant’s Volcano has been vastly improved[/b]
[*] Various tweaks and adjustments
[/list]
[h2]Optimization and Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]There are now graphics quality settings[/b] to turn down in case things are still getting a little framey
[*] Blood Hunt effects are now clearer and more expressive
[/list]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where you could sometimes mutate a spell and nothing would change
[*] Stopped certain objects from disappearing when partially offscreen
[*] Fixed researched card from increasing in size when spamming the research button
[*] Fixed issue where you could change spells by clicking on the hotbar while paused (though you can still change spells by clicking on the hotbar while the game is running normally)
[*] Various small bug fixes and tweaks
[/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressed The Button
[/list]

Edit: 1.0.1 hotfix is out, make sure to update! Just some minor balancing and fixes.

notes.title: Infinite Incantation Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE[/b]: 0.2.1 Hotfix fixes the issue where the money multiplier would not initialize unless the shop was opened. Now there's no issue. Sorry about that!

Hello everyone, we have another update prepared for Infinite Incantation.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced enemy load resulting in much higher framerates across the board 
[*] Bountiful remote detonation and similar combinations will no longer cause freezing when casting 
[*] Other minor tweaks
[*] The game should run better now, please let us know!
[/list]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Refunding now has a cost - so plan carefully!
[*] The amount and strengths of Spell Archetypes you Exclude now affect a [b]money gain multiplier[/b]. Going into a level with a less-than-advantageous deck will now give you [b]more money[/b], and egregiously stacking the deck in your favour might cause your [b]total money gain to decrease
[/b][*] Double the [b]money multiplier[/b] with the cheat code [spoiler]HARDMONEYEASY[/spoiler]
[*] Upgrading Earth affinity also increases the size of earth spells
[*] 5 new Spell Archetypes: Zipper, Crop Dusters, Morebiting, Scrubber, and Spiral Collapse
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay and Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dexterity stat now increases base critical hit chance
[*] Luck stat has been buffed slightly
[*] Cost of upgrading Affinities has been decreased
[*] Cost of upgrading stats has changed slightly
[*] Flask upgrades cost less and you receive more from beating bosses
[*] On Passive spell effects have increased in size
[*] Last 2 bosses of every level have increased in size

[*] Returning to the Tower no longer opens the Title Screen
[*] Tutorial now shows up after returning to the Tower for the first time so first-time players can have more context for its explanations
[*] Nerfed final boss of Vagrant’s Volcano slightly (this boss will be reworked in later updates)
[*] Removed the ability to get Bountiful upgrade on Star
[/list]

[h3]Bugs Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the player could not interact with level portals or the shop upon loading cloud saves on another device
[*] Larger enemies no longer push you around
[*] Fixed rare issues when rebinding controls
[*] Fixed another Cannon Ape T-pose issue
[*] Figure-8 no longer can receive blood effects 
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Visual clarity tweaks to 3D models and effects
[*] Minor tweaks to hitboxes of level obstacles
[*] Reconfigured input scrunting
[/list]

notes.title: Infinite Incantation Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello, thanks to everyone who bought and wishlisted the first version of our game! We've just sent out an update to our next minor version: 0.1.1.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Results screen now shows you what new spell archetypes you collected from achievements in the level
[*]5 New archetypes: Boomerang, Figure-8, Satellites, Ellipse, Star
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay and Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Scrolling the mouse wheel to select spells now goes in the opposite direction
[*]Chain lightning’s chains go deeper and hit more enemies
[*]Reduced the base price of exclusions and added more of them
[*]Slightly buffed the archetypes: Bolas, Wipers, Antlers, Whirl, Cosmic Knot
[*]Made Floating Eyeball enemies less aggressive
[*]Reworked difficulty spike in Haunted Hovel at around 5:50-4:00 in the countdown
[*]Removed Thorn Bushes from the final bosses of levels and buffed those bosses
[*]Slightly reworked the final boss of Vagrant’s Volcano
[/list]
[h3]Bugs Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where a spell might not fire, or be fired as a part of another spell occasionally 
[*]Fixed a Cannon Ape T-posing issue
[*]Fixed issue where the XP Thief would size up other enemies and level up other XP Thieves
[*]Fixed rare issue where the final boss of Vagrant’s Volcano would get stuck in a location far from the player
[/list]
[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced lag spikes when spawning a lot of enemies at once, slightly increasing framerates towards the end of levels (The next update will contain a lot more improvements)  
[*]Reworked some spell effects to be more optimized
[*]Lowered maximum number of enemies
[/list] 
[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*]Renamed achievements from “without using a Flask” to “at max Flasks”
[*]Minor visual clarity tweaks in some 3D models and effects
[*]Minor audio mixing improvements
[*]Minor UI changes
[/list] 

We’re already working on balancing, better optimization, and more content for updates soon, so stay tuned!
